run_online_tracking_demo: run the online demo script to compute point tracks on a video using CoTracker3 online model
run_tracking_with_checkpoint: run the online demo with a custom checkpoint path to load a specific CoTracker model
run_tracking_with_grid_config: run the online demo with a custom grid size and query frame for track computation
review_CoTrackerOnlinePredictor: review the CoTrackerOnlinePredictor class used to predict point tracks from video chunks in an online manner
review_Visualizer: review the Visualizer class used to render predicted tracks and visibility onto video frames
